obfuscation_indicators: no assurance that such capital will be available
risk_summary: The disclosure is heavily quantified and explains major year-over-year changes, but it reflects materially worsening operating and net losses, a large impairment charge, and reliance on equity financing and future licensing revenues. Liquidity is presented as sufficient for the next fiscal year, while management acknowledges that additional capital may be needed and may not be available on acceptable terms.
